reference.unstructured: On 8th January 2021, Web of Science was used to generate a list of articles which cited each functional’s paper since 2013 (when BEEF-vdW was published). This list of articles was searched for either “oxygen evolution reaction” or “oxygen reduction reaction”. The number of papers in each of these searches was then totalled to give 220, 1578, 474 and 125 for PW91, PBE, RPBE and BEEF-vdW respectively.
